title: Five numbers worth knowing about your heart
excerpt: Blood pressure, resting pulse, cholesterol, blood sugar and waist size. What each one tells us, and when it is worth having them checked.
content:
Most heart problems give years of warning, in numbers that are easy to measure. Five of them cover most of what we look at in a routine check.

  • Blood pressure
  • Resting pulse
  • Cholesterol
  • Blood sugar
  • Waist measurement

Why the trend matters more than one reading

A single high reading on a busy morning tells us little. Three readings over a few weeks tell us a great deal. That is why we may ask you to measure at home, or to come back.

When to have them checked

If you are over forty and have not had these measured in the last three years, a check is sensible. It takes twenty minutes and one blood sample. You can book it like any other appointment.

This article is general information and not personal medical advice. If you are worried about your health, please make an appointment.
